PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
EC-Council Certified SOC Analyst (CSA) and Security Platform Engineer specializing in 24/7 security operations, SOAR playbook
automation, log source onboarding, and detection engineering. Hands-on experience architecting security orchestration stacks utilizing
**Docker, ELK Stack/Wazuh, n8n, and TheHive**, coupled with automated threat intelligence ingestion via **AlienVault OTX, VirusTotal,
and AbuseIPDB**. Experienced in Python-driven threat analytics and incident triage workflows. Seeking to deliver on-site security
operations and platform administration in Qatar or Dubai.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
• Security Operations & Triage - 24/7 Monitoring, Incident Response, Alert Triage, Root Cause Analysis, MITRE ATT&CK Framework,
Threat Hunting, IoC Correlation
• SIEM & Security Analytics - Splunk, Elastic Stack (ELK), OpenSearch, Wazuh, Log Parser/Normalization, Detection Rules
• SOAR & Automation - n8n Workflow Automation, TheHive Case Management, Threat Intelligence (AlienVault OTX, VirusTotal,
AbuseIPDB), Webhook Integrations
• Security Tools & Environment - Wireshark, Nmap, Nikto, Burp Suite, Docker Containerization, Linux (Ubuntu/Kali), Windows Server,
Git
• Scripting & AI/ML - Python (scikit-learn, REST APIs), Bash, Machine Learning Detection Models (Isolation Forest, Random Forest)
SECURITY OPERATIONS EXPERIENCE
• 09.2025 – 05.2026
Jr. Cybersecurity Analyst — SOC Operations | Wahy Labs
– Monitored, triaged, and investigated real-time security alerts using SIEM platforms (Splunk, Wazuh) across network endpoints and
firewalls.
– Ingested and parsed log telemetry from server and security controls; validated indicators of compromise (IoCs) and mapped attack
techniques to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
– Engineered automated triage scripts in Python to enrich incoming IP/URL indicators against threat intelligence feeds, reducing
manual analyst lookup time.
– Performed root-cause analysis and documented detailed incident timelines, evidence captures, and mitigation steps for escalated
tickets.
• 02.2025 – 07.2025
CICSA Trainee — Security Operations | RedTeam Hacker Academy
– Completed intensive hands-on SOC training covering incident handling, log inspection, perimeter security monitoring, and vulner-
ability assessment routines.
SECURITY PLATFORM ENGINEERING PROJECTS
• Containerized Security Orchestration & SOAR Lab
Docker, ELK Stack, n8n, TheHive, OTX
Designed and deployed a local SOAR ecosystem inside Docker containers running Elasticsearch, Kibana, n8n, and TheHive. Inte-
grated n8n automation nodes to ingest Kali Linux attack logs, automatically query AlienVault OTX, and trigger incident case creation
in TheHive.
• Multi-Agent AI Threat Detection & Pipeline
Python, Llama 3, VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB
Engineered an automated threat intelligence pipeline that extracts firewall logs, queries external threat intelligence APIs (VirusTotal,
AbuseIPDB), enriches logs with GeoIP telemetry, and compiles risk reports.
• ML Log Anomaly Analytics Tool
Python, Scikit-learn, Isolation Forest
Developed a security monitoring script employing Isolation Forest and Random Forest algorithms to analyze server access logs and
detect uncharacteristic user authentication activity.
